planned_title: How Close Will Gliese 710 Come to the Sun?
spoken: Gliese 710 passes at about a fifth of a light-year. Make the gap between the sun and Earth one centimeter. Neptune, our outermost planet, is then 30 centimeters away, about the length of a ruler. So the star will not come anywhere near the planets. more than 100 meters away, the length of a football pitch.
